Problem Statement
Read a temperature in Celsius and print its Fahrenheit value, using a function that takes a float and returns a float.
Description
Read a temperature celsius as a float from input. Write a function celsius To Fahrenheit that takes a float parameter, applies the formula F = C * 9 / 5 + 32, and returns the result as a float. Call the function from main() and print the returned value with exactly two digits after the decimal point.
Input Description
A single number celsius (it may be negative or have decimals).
Output Description
Print the temperature in Fahrenheit with two digits after the decimal point.
Sample Input
100
Sample Output
212.00
